btosAiUseAnyFunction.name: Firms Using AI (Any Function)
btosAiUseAnyFunction.unit: percent of U.S. businesses, prior two weeks
btosAiUseAnyFunction.source: Census Bureau, Business Trends and Outlook Survey (National file)

btosAiUseOriginal.name: Firms Using AI (Original Question)
btosAiUseOriginal.unit: percent of U.S. businesses, prior two weeks
btosAiUseOriginal.source: Census Bureau, Business Trends and Outlook Survey (AI Core Questions file)

canariesMidCareerExposed.name: Mid-Career Workers in AI-Exposed Jobs
canariesMidCareerExposed.unit: employment index, ages 35–40 in the most AI-exposed occupation quintile, November 2022 = 100
canariesMidCareerExposed.source: Stanford Digital Economy Lab, AI Economic Indicators (Brynjolfsson, Chandar & Chen, "Canaries in the Coal Mine")

canariesYoungExposed.name: Young Workers in AI-Exposed Jobs
canariesYoungExposed.unit: employment index, ages 22–25 in the most AI-exposed occupation quintile, November 2022 = 100
canariesYoungExposed.source: Stanford Digital Economy Lab, AI Economic Indicators (Brynjolfsson, Chandar & Chen, "Canaries in the Coal Mine")

cesBusinessSupport.name: Business Support Jobs (Call Centers)
cesBusinessSupport.source: BLS Current Employment Statistics, via FRED CES6056140001

cesComputerSystemsDesign.name: Computer Systems Design Jobs
cesComputerSystemsDesign.source: BLS Current Employment Statistics, via FRED CES6054150001

cesComputingInfrastructure.name: Computing Infrastructure Jobs
cesComputingInfrastructure.source: BLS Current Employment Statistics, via FRED CES5051800001

cesInformation.name: Information Sector Jobs
cesInformation.source: BLS Current Employment Statistics, via FRED USINFO

cesTemporaryHelp.name: Temporary Help Jobs
cesTemporaryHelp.source: BLS Current Employment Statistics, via FRED TEMPHELPS

challengerAiJobCuts.name: Job Cuts Attributed to AI
challengerAiJobCuts.unit: announced job cuts per year citing artificial intelligence as the reason
challengerAiJobCuts.source: Challenger, Gray & Christmas, Job Cut Announcement Report

fiverrActiveBuyers.name: Fiverr Active Buyers
fiverrActiveBuyers.unit: thousands of buyers who ordered in the prior 12 months, at year-end
fiverrActiveBuyers.source: Fiverr International Ltd., Forms 20-F and 6-K (SEC EDGAR)

gallupAiUseAny.name: Employees Using AI at Work
gallupAiUseAny.unit: percent of U.S. employees using AI in their role at least a few times a year

gallupAiUseDaily.name: Employees Using AI Daily
gallupAiUseDaily.unit: percent of U.S. employees using AI in their role daily

genAiAdoptionWork.name: Workers Using GenAI for Work
genAiAdoptionWork.source: Real-Time Population Survey (Bick, Blandin & Deming), via FRED RPSGENAIUSAGESHAREWORK

indeedAiPostingsShare.name: Job Postings Mentioning AI (Indeed)
indeedAiPostingsShare.unit: percent of US job postings, monthly average of daily values
indeedAiPostingsShare.source: Indeed Hiring Lab AI Tracker (GitHub, CC BY 4.0)

indeedPostingsAll.name: Job Postings Index (Indeed)
indeedPostingsAll.unit: index, February 1, 2020 = 100, monthly average of daily values, seasonally adjusted
indeedPostingsAll.source: Indeed Hiring Lab, via FRED IHLIDXUS

indeedPostingsCustomerService.name: Customer Service Postings (Indeed)
indeedPostingsCustomerService.unit: index, February 1, 2020 = 100, monthly average of daily values, seasonally adjusted
indeedPostingsCustomerService.source: Indeed Hiring Lab, via FRED IHLIDXUSTPCUSTSERV

indeedPostingsSoftware.name: Software Postings Index (Indeed)
indeedPostingsSoftware.unit: index, February 1, 2020 = 100, monthly average of daily values, seasonally adjusted
indeedPostingsSoftware.source: Indeed Hiring Lab, via FRED IHLIDXUSTPSOFTDEVE

initialClaims.name: Initial Jobless Claims
initialClaims.unit: initial claims per week, seasonally adjusted, monthly average
initialClaims.source: US Employment and Training Administration, via FRED ICSA

joltsHires.name: Hires
joltsHires.unit: hires per month, thousands, seasonally adjusted
joltsHires.source: BLS Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, via FRED JTSHIL

joltsLayoffs.name: Layoffs & Discharges
joltsLayoffs.unit: layoffs and discharges per month, thousands, seasonally adjusted
joltsLayoffs.source: BLS Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, via FRED JTSLDL

joltsOpenings.name: Job Openings
joltsOpenings.unit: openings, thousands, seasonally adjusted, last business day of month
joltsOpenings.source: BLS Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey, via FRED JTSJOL

oewsComputerProgrammers.name: Computer Programmers Employed
oewsComputerProgrammers.source: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (SOC 15-1251)

oewsCustomerServiceReps.name: Customer Service Reps Employed
oewsCustomerServiceReps.source: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (SOC 43-4051)

oewsDataEntryKeyers.name: Data Entry Keyers Employed
oewsDataEntryKeyers.source: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (SOC 43-9021)

oewsSoftwareDevelopers.name: Software Developers Employed
oewsSoftwareDevelopers.source: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (SOC 15-1252)

publicExpectsFewerJobs.name: Expect AI to Reduce Jobs
publicExpectsFewerJobs.unit: percent of U.S. adults expecting AI to reduce the total number of U.S. jobs over the next 10 years
publicExpectsFewerJobs.source: Bentley University–Gallup Business in Society study

rampAiIndex.name: Businesses Paying for AI (Ramp)
rampAiIndex.unit: percent of US businesses on Ramp with a paid AI transaction in the month
rampAiIndex.source: Ramp Economics Lab, Ramp AI Index

recentGradUnderemployment.name: Recent Grad Underemployment
recentGradUnderemployment.unit: percent working in jobs that do not typically require a college degree, ages 22–27 with a bachelor's degree or higher
recentGradUnderemployment.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, The Labor Market for Recent College Graduates

recentGradUnemployment.name: Recent Grad Unemployment
recentGradUnemployment.unit: percent, ages 22–27 with a bachelor's degree or higher, seasonally adjusted 3-month average
recentGradUnemployment.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, The Labor Market for Recent College Graduates

upworkGsv.name: Upwork Gross Services Volume
upworkGsv.unit: thousands of US dollars transacted per year
upworkGsv.source: Upwork Inc., Form 10-K key metrics (SEC EDGAR)

yaleOccupationalChurn.name: Occupational Churn
yaleOccupationalChurn.unit: dissimilarity index, percentage-point shift in the occupational mix over the prior 12 months, 12-month moving average
yaleOccupationalChurn.source: Yale Budget Lab, Tracking the Impact of AI on the Labor Market (from CPS microdata)
